commons.query: generator=geosearch over 4x4 circles of 1800 m, 200 nearest files each, not split (crawl capped); camera coordinate inside the tile

inaturalist.query: bbox, research grade, Plantae, geoprivacy open, acc_below 50, order_by votes, 3 pages of 200

rules: Commons files with a primary camera coordinate inside the tile and iNaturalist research-grade Plantae observations with open coordinates (accuracy < 50 m), CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA only; JPEG, rendition >= 1000 px wide, aspect 1.2-2.2, taken 2000 or later when dated; no title/description/category keyword for buildings, people, vehicles, signs, maps, aerial views, historical images, close-ups of organisms, night, sunrise/sunset/dusk or snow/winter; no title that is only a Latin binomial; no Flickr-import title '<words> (digits).jpg' whose words and description name no place or landscape feature; sun at least 10 deg up at the photo's clock time (lower of standard and daylight offsets) when a time is known; after download not greyscale (mean saturation >= 0.07), mean luminance >= 0.18, a real sky (sky-coloured pixels with 5x5 mean gradient < 0.03, connected to the top edge, covering >= 0.2 of the top quarter) with land below (>= 0.6 of the lower half not sky), detail spread (>= 0.5 of lower-half 8x8 cells holding >= 0.2 of the busiest cell's), and land not in silhouette (land luminance >= 0.3 x sky luminance); selected heading-known first, then greedy farthest-point in tile metres >= 300 m apart, <= 3 from iNaturalist, ties by larger image then id. Candidates never reached by the selection were not downloaded.
